title: Haslet
preamble:
8 oz stale white bread, cubed

1 medium onion, chopped

Milk for soaking

1 teaspoon chopped fresh sage

2lb lean pork, coarsely minced
method: Soak the bread and squeeze out moisture
Grease 2 and 1/2 lb loaf tin Put in mixture and press down
Bake for 1 and 1/2 hours covered in foil
Cool a little before turning out and serve cold
